Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: Lucas Figueroa
Message:
Medina V2 Phase 04 G4.1: integration holdout SEALED — 30 dev / 16 holdout, digest-locked, before any pipeline run

The V4 integration holdout is sealed BEFORE tuning, before the harness
that could run a case even exists (D046 discipline; the methodology and
its split salt were committed at b319e77, before any case was drafted).

The first batch: 46 pipeline cases across all 11 strata, drafted by 7
Opus agents from graduated channel goldens + fresh corpus, then verified
by an independent Opus pass that re-derived EVERY expected review state
from the real code constants (identity bands, 0.8 validated threshold,
advisory cap, D050a 0.40 gap both sides, 0.6 recency floor,
policy-sensitive wins, D052a corroboration) with zero arithmetic errors,
and confirmed all 26 channel-golden source-artifact citations and every
provenance ref. Architect adjudication: data_reality convention
normalized (verified_real only for verified production identity),
assumed_incoming surfaced machine-auditably on conflict cases, one
resolution-field contradiction fixed, world-scaffold enum literals fixed,
one malformed guard reshaped. All 46 normalized to one canonical
assertion schema BEFORE sealing (the seal records digests).

The split is mechanical and reproduced twice independently (architect
reference implementation + the seal script's reimplementation — exact
match required and achieved): salted fnv64 over case_ids, same-artifact
union-find atomicity (a shared source artifact never straddles the
split), holdout_only/dev_only forcing from channel-split sourcing rules,
greedy unit fill per stratum. conflict_supersession grew 2→3 forced by
its channel-holdout-sourced members. Trace companies (uLogic, Tier4,
ONID) are dev-only by construction. Every stratum is represented on both
sides.

Seal mechanics (ledger row 510, kind holdout_sealed): per-file SHA-256
digests + full assignment + eligibility inputs + salt + git sha.
loadPipelineHoldoutSuite carries the LAB_MODE=graduate tripwire, the
holdout_access audit row, AND digest verification — a holdout file
altered after sealing fails graduation loudly. Contamination test
extended (+7): tripwire, tamper detection, extra-file detection,
no-seal-row failure, dev-loader import-graph isolation. vitest 847/847.

Also: v4-design gains §6.5, the harness implementation contract (world
seeding for real-artifact-backed cases, @input_hash/@patch_key symbolic
resolvers, three caller modes with cassette keying, band-tolerant
review-state scoring, assumed_incoming divergence semantics, false-apply
actor scoping). G4.3 builds to it next.

Known shortfalls, named not hidden (gate-report items): S1 holdout is
news/explicit-link flavored only (no holdout-capable clean conversation
case existed in unused corpus); the D052a corroboration surface is
dev-only; S5/S7 off-subject-metric expectations assume the company_name
gate-prompt line that lands at the live tier (G4.6). Owner spot-check of
this first batch happens at the G4 boundary per D050/D051 precedent.

Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: Lucas Figueroa
Message:
Medina V2 Phase 04 G4 CLOSE: honest metrics, band-consistency, holdout graduation — gate RED on correctness, GREEN on all safety bars

The gate's final measurements, all ledgered and replay-deterministic:

- V4 false-apply: 0.0000 dev (0/107) AND holdout (0/26) — the FAR
  definition corrected to actual-wrongness (wrong entity / contradicted
  expectation / doctrine-violating trust) after three rounds proved the
  exhaustiveness rule flagged only verified-correct extractions;
  unenumerated extractions now a reported audit-loop feed
  (threshold_change rows ledgered, bar unchanged).
- V4 correctness: 0.895 dev / 0.772 holdout (bar 0.90) — RED. Graduation
  ran once, digest-verified, single ledgered access
  (pipeline-holdout-20260705000439-nip216, $1.15). Miss anatomy: 13/15
  model-extraction quality, 1 oracle friction, 1 infrastructure
  (SOURCE_FETCH_FAILED on a cache-missed row during the known
  UTC-midnight wrangler auth window — excluding it, holdout ~0.827).
  ZERO assembly defects; the single critical is the model emitting a
  link as a display name — the exact class the case exists to catch.
- Drills: resume 1.000, corruption containment 1.000, honest N/A lists.
- Traces: 7/7 PASS (ONID + Caspia re-run clean through the enum fix).

Also in this commit: positional cassette keys (byte-identical replay,
proven twice), deterministic same-millisecond tie-breaks in
fact-ledger/fact-merge (production fix, pinned, full battery green),
band_shift_count trust-precision telemetry, the state-band consistency
rulings applied mechanically dev+holdout (92 conversions, all
doctrine-determined states kept strict), D030 suggestion-scoping,
contacts_links-003 alignment, ms-001 scoping-only oracle, seal rounds
4-6 (membership stable since round 2; full supersession chain in the
ledger).

The finalized gate report (phase-04-g4-gate-report.md) is the D049
boundary document: RED on one bar, GREEN on nine, five owner decisions
enumerated, recommendation = one channel-quality iteration then one
re-graduation. G5 does not start without the owner's explicit go.
Phase live spend ~$15 of $300.
